evidence_grades.label: Confirmed
evidence_grades.means: You would defend this in front of a sceptic: independent sources agree, or a system record backs it.

evidence_grades.label: Indicated
evidence_grades.means: A reasonable reading of limited evidence: one good source, or several of the same kind.

evidence_grades.label: Hypothesis
evidence_grades.means: Not yet tested: AI output, self-report, or marketing. Never drives a decision on its own.

thesis.serve: Airlines, freight forwarders and food-service customers who need reliable turnarounds at scale.
thesis.outcome: Aircraft and cargo that leave on time, safely, with nothing left behind.

principles.principle: Decisions are made at the station, by one named role.
principles.refuted_by: Event records showing a different role deciding in more than one case in five.

principles.principle: Standard work is written once and run everywhere.
principles.refuted_by: Three or more routes for the same step across shifts.

principles.principle: AI takes the rule-based work; people keep the judgement.
principles.refuted_by: An automated step that still needs a person to correct it most days.

principles.principle: Capability is built ahead of growth, not after it.
principles.refuted_by: Anchor seats still absent two cycles after a growth decision.

leapfrog_gate.test: Standards for clear, rule-based work are written so a machine can run and check them
Standards are refreshed on a fixed cadence from how the work is actually done
AI is built into daily management and problem solving, not bolted on
Human judgement is protected and developed in complex work
The design installs faster than competitors can in a new unit

evidence_rules.rule: Every finding carries a grade: Confirmed, Indicated or Hypothesis. The grade is the assessor's judgement, made with the evidence in view.
A Hypothesis never drives a decision on its own.
One assessor scores each cell; the rationale and sources are recorded so the score can be challenged.
At least 5 cases behind any step metric.
At least 30 desire-pulse responses per role group; any task mapping below 0.70 confidence is reviewed by a person.
Archetype fit stays a Hypothesis until process evidence tests it.
Value figures are estimates until finance validates them.

decision_log.decision: Thesis, design principles, reference model, criteria and evidence rules
Step dispositions and the top operating-system gaps
The combined model-and-system design, and first-tranche funding

org_modeling.strategy_text:
Who we serve: Airlines, freight forwarders and food-service customers who need reliable turnarounds at scale.
The outcome we sell: Aircraft and cargo that leave on time, safely, with nothing left behind.
The profit formula: Paid per unit handled; margin comes from labour productivity and renewal pricing.
The moat: Licences, network breadth and judgement built over years in safety-critical work.
The scale logic: Each new station is cheaper to bring up once the operating routines are standard.

Design principles:
P1 Decisions are made at the station, by one named role.
P2 Standard work is written once and run everywhere.
P3 AI takes the rule-based work; people keep the judgement.
P4 Capability is built ahead of growth, not after it.

Capability priorities (highest value exposure first):
CAP-03 Technology, Data & AI — maturity 3.25/4, improving, 30% of economic weight. Priority move: Scale the digital core + drive data standardisation + AI CoE globally.
CAP-04 Commercial Leadership — maturity 3/4, improving, 22% of economic weight. Priority move: Fill the commercial bench + activate global accounts + per-country growth plans.
CAP-01 Gateway / Hub Services — maturity 3.25/4, improving, 21% of economic weight. Priority move: Scale hub-of-the-future globally + close the safety-culture gap urgently.
CAP-05 Enterprise Leadership — maturity 3.5/4, stable, 12% of economic weight. Priority move: Scale leadership development globally + close the bottom-quintile long tail.
CAP-02 Food & Catering Solutions — maturity 3.5/4, stable, 10% of economic weight. Priority move: Monetise waste-intelligence platform + arrest the cultural decline.
CAP-06 Human Capital & Enabling — maturity 3.25/4, improving, 5% of economic weight. Priority move: Build people analytics + activate the engagement framework at scale.
